{{Quote|What begins, ends.<br />What is born, dies.<br />All that is made can be un-made.<br />Dark has no meaning without light,<br />And for all living things<br />there is the final<br />silence.|"Life's Memories," published in ''Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode on an Odon''|<ref name="Memories" />}}
'''''Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode on an Odon''''' was an anthology that was edited by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Soshu Londahl]] and published by [[Coruscani Publishing]]. "[[Life's Memories (Londahl)|Life's Memories]]," a poem written in the [[Ithorese/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]], was translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] by Londahl and included in the anthology. Because the poem discussed the nature of [[Death/Legends|death]], it was later quoted in an [[Life's Memories (Herrera and Reston)|academic pager]], also called Life's Memories, that also discussed death. The paper, written by [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]], contained a footnote that stated that the poem had originally appeared in ''Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode to an Odon'' and listed its publisher and editor.<ref name="Memories" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode to an Odon'' was mentioned in "[[Life's Memories (article)|Life's Memories]]," an article that tied into the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Belted In: Excursion|Excursion]]'' and was written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[July 3]], [[2003]] as part of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force Campaign]].<ref name="Memories" />
